name: Dr. Patrick Nepper
headline: Group Product Manager, Google Chrome
summary:
Group Product Manager at the Google Safety Engineering Center in Munich, Germany. Leading a team of product managers focused on helping people around the world take actionable goals to completion. Dad, runner, politician, councilman and ex-entrepreneur.

The views expressed here are my own and do not represent the views of my employer.

I am a product leader with a passion for making technology more intuitive and secure. I studied computer science at Ludwig‑Maximilians‑Universität München focusing on mobile and distributed systems and computational linguistics. My diploma thesis centred on using spoken‑dialogue interfaces to provide location-based services on the go — a concept later published as ‘Adding Speech to Location‑based Services’.

After earning my PhD from the Technical University of Munich, I joined Google’s Chrome team, where I now lead cross‑functional efforts to integrate AI and security features into the browser. My goal is to bring cutting‑edge AI to billions of users in a way that is seamless, secure and respectful of privacy.
